The '''Tython Orbital Station''' was a Republic [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that orbited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the subsequent [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

Located in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core's]] [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]], the station served as a waystation for those arriving at the homeworld of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. As the planet had only two landing facilities, located at the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] and the [[Masters' Retreat]], travelers were required to dock their ship at the station and take a shuttle down to the planet's surface.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tython Orbital Station was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. It serves as the spaceport for the Republic-only planet Tython, and can only be accessed by Republic players with their own ship. Players then can take a shuttle down to the Jedi Temple on the planet's surface.<ref name="TOR" />
